label: ENGINEERING_ONLY
comment: Track P P.4 phase 1: the H200 SFT fit and timing probe (P4-PROBE A, P4-PROBECAP A; cluster test plan docs/r1/reports/trackp_p4_runner_20261122/P4_CLUSTER_TEST_PLAN_20261124.md §4), one HTCondor job per base, image v2.2. This committed file is a TEMPLATE: it is never filled in place. The cluster fills a copy in exactly three fields (paper.commit: the published host-config fill commit carrying the probe mode; image.versions_sha256: T1's value; host_config.sha256: T3's file sha256), and commits that copy with the probe record. p4_lib.check_probe_template (at staging and in the job) refuses any other difference. Everything else equals p4_spec.json, except run_id (outside the P.4 run's sealed tree, F10) and the fixed probe block. The label fields, estimate and caps.probe_gpu_hours stay placeholders: the probe reads none of them. The run id's date is the date this template was written, not the date of the run.

image.versions_sha256_comment: Filled in the launch commit, from a cluster record on main. Procedure: the cluster agent runs `sha256sum /opt/r1/VERSIONS.txt && cat /opt/r1/VERSIONS.txt` inside the digest-pinned v2.2 gpu image on NEMO2, as an HTCondor job with the same header as the staged smoke (docs/r1/reports/trackp_h200_20261118/stages/smoke_h200/probe.jdl: universe = container, container_image = docker://<this image.digest>, the NEMO2 requirements); there is no explicit apptainer command in those scripts, HTCondor runs the container. It commits the VERSIONS.txt text together with that sha256 line (or commits the handback captures of 759994/759997/760000, whose probe scripts cat /opt/r1/VERSIONS.txt, with the sha256 of the exact file). The I2 identity's versions_sha256 is of the cpu image and does not apply.

caps.probe_gpu_hours_comment: P4-PROBECAP A (R1-P4-TESTPLAN-DECISIONS): the probe's GPU-hours count against the 40 GPU-h. p4_lib.probe_records sums the charge of every sealed attempt of every trackp-p4-probe-* run (STOP attempts and repeats included; a killed attempt at the probe's walltime) and rounds it up to 0.01; the same value goes into the probe record's one 'p4_probe_gpu_hours: <hours>' line (p4_switch check) and the note's gpu_hours_cap: line ('probe_gpu_hours: <hours>'). Launch validation requires it; the projection, charged_hours, assemble and the switch's check_cap add it. caps.probe_charge_files lists the probe charge files (_wallclock.json and any _wallclock.<n>.json) by sha256 in file order, as the probe record's p4_probe_charge_file: lines give them; check_probe_ledger (in assemble and check_cap) refuses a changed, missing or unlisted charge file.

estimate.source: TODO: h200_sft_probe: <probe record>; until then the draft's P4-CAP 8x case (0.8B 0.83 h of training without early stopping under P3; 4B = 8 x 0.8B)
estimate.hours_comment: The 8x hours above are placeholders for the preview only. At launch, validate_spec requires estimate.source 'h200_sft_probe: docs/r1/reports/<record>.md', and p4_switch check requires that record on origin/main with one line 'p4_estimate_hours: <arm> <hours>' per arm equal to these values (check_probe_hours), so the 8x hours cannot be launched unless the probe gives exactly them.

probe.rule: P4-PROBE A (R1-P4-TESTPLAN-DECISIONS): at most 50 steps of sft-dev on synthetic labels, one job per base, nothing kept as an arm; it counts as no training run. walltime_s is the probe job's +RequestWalltime and the charge of a probe attempt with no readable record.
